title: Update and immutable lock mapping
summary: Exact M0 map of portable init/update behavior, Framework locking and deterministic build evidence.
current_behavior: Framework runtime, manifests and asset projection are pinned to commit hashes and validated fail closed.
init creates the portable JSON/Markdown surface; init --update preserves existing files and restores only missing starter files.
Two exact-code M0 builds were byte-identical.
Composer archive and git export exclude local/development surfaces.
known_deviations: The repository has no composer.lock, so dependency resolution is not immutable across future installs.
Update exposes no accepted dry-run/diff report or rollback package.
Preserve-or-add-missing behavior is not the full engine-owned versus project-owned migration contract.
M0 formatter and two documentation-count tests are red.
deletion_gates: Do not replace init --update until a dry-run, ownership manifest, rollback package and preservation matrix pass.
Do not change Framework locks without exact tuple compatibility and asset projection evidence.
Decide and test product dependency-lock ownership before claiming reproducible clean installation.
